performance_accounting.accounting_note: Prior checkpoints are cumulative, not additive. The baseline latest checkpoint remains36.7556981s. Final production source rebuilt after edits; its performance execution starts from zero and includes every final owner-probe process below. Builds and correctness checks excluded. No timing samples pooled across versions/settings.

limitations: Three samples per case are not a confidence interval; retain all observed values.
Owner selection always runs automatic, twelve, sixteen in one process; later cases can benefit from time, temperature, cache and allocator changes.
Twelve changes classifier owners16 to12 as well as recognition ownership; its Medium advantage does not isolate recognition scheduling.
Model families share one dense fixture; this is not sparse-page, concurrent-throughput or native-NEON qualification.
Windows memory metrics are peak private commit, not RSS; cumulative process peaks do not isolate owner-config memory differences.
Capacity24 is measured; capacities25..31 are inferred from identical sixteen-owner/one-base-thread arithmetic, with boundary correctness checks but no physical performance samples there.
Final automatic and baseline automatic ran in sequential preserved/rebuilt processes; three samples on one host/fixture do not establish statistical significance or corpus-wide performance.
Direct cross-executable complete owned output was not exported by the baseline owner probe; equality is checked within each executable plus serial integration coverage.
More private owners increase retained request capacity and can trigger configured engine idle-cache eviction; activation limits remain per session and no owner-reduction fallback is added.
The minimum32unit threshold requires two jobs per owner, but performance samples are at69units; not every qualifying geometry was benchmarked.
